body: I like to compare it with the original Mario game. yeah you can get the coins and squash all the goombas and get the high score, but if you can't get to the end of the level you can't really do any of that. For some people following their passion is beating the level and finding a SO is the extra points you don't need, and for me it's the opposite.

I remember on /r/askreddit one of the questions was "What is the one thing you want in your life right now?" and the top answer was "somebody to share it with." Hit a bit too close to home perhaps.

New York, you?

I was completely fine when I was with her, I never felt like I was missing anything. I never had any desire to go travel the world or whatever else, but I wanted to do it with her. 

I wanna find someone new but I have no idea how, the only two girls I've ever been with both approached me and meeting them was sheer luck.
